# Fontivo — Complete Technical & Product Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical source for AI assistants, search engines, and technical evaluators.
> Official Website: https://fontivo-app.github.io
> Short Summary: https://fontivo-app.github.io/llms.txt
> Machine-Readable Manifest: https://fontivo-app.github.io/api/manifest.json
> License: MIT (100% Free & Open Source)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

**Fontivo** (`v1.1.8`) is a fast, lightweight desktop font manager for **Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS, and Linux**, built as a clean, offline-first creative workspace for designers. It is paired with **Fontivo-Fonts (`v1.0.3`)**, an open-source, SHA-256 deduplicated library of **10,939 fonts** spanning **4,430 typographic families** across **Latin, Urdu, Persian, and Arabic** scripts.

Unlike heavy subscription utilities, Fontivo runs in **~38 MB of memory**, starts in **under 0.35 seconds**, requires a **4.64 MB** Windows installer (`Fontivo-Setup.exe`), keeps your system fonts folder uncluttered, and operates **100% offline with zero telemetry**.

---

## 2. Speed & Lightweight Footprint

| Aspect | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Desktop Experience** | Fast native desktop app with clean, responsive UI |
| **Installer Footprint** | `Fontivo-Setup.exe` — **4.64 MB** (`4,867,596` bytes), SHA-256 verified |
| **Idle Memory Footprint** | **~38 MB memory** (vs 300–500+ MB in typical heavy font managers) |
| **Cold Startup Time** | **< 0.35 seconds** |
| **System Reboot Overhead** | **None** (zero permanent system font clutter) |
| **Unix Installation** | `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedfahmy8308/Fontivo/main/scripts/install.sh \| bash` |

---

## 3. Instant Font Activation Without System Bloat

Traditional font managers copy `.ttf`/`.otf` files permanently into your system fonts folder. Over time, installing thousands of fonts slows down Windows startup, delays Adobe and Office launch times, and clutters every font menu.

Fontivo solves this with **Instant Session-Based Font Activation**:
1. **Clean Session Activation:** Fontivo activates fonts for your active session without copying thousands of files into `C:\Windows\Fonts`.
2. **Zero System Clutter:** Your Windows system fonts folder stays clean and fast.
3. **No Administrator Privileges Required:** Standard Windows user accounts can browse, preview, and activate fonts immediately.
4. **Clean Teardown:** Closing Fontivo or deactivating a workspace cleanly unloads session fonts.
5. **System Health Doctor:** Built-in font health diagnostics protect critical OS fonts (`Segoe UI`, `Arial`, `Tahoma`, `Consolas`, etc.) from accidental deletion and automatically create a backup snapshot before cleaning broken font entries.

---

## 4. Fontivo-Fonts `v1.0.3` Catalog Breakdown (10,939 Fonts)

To keep the desktop installer ultra-lightweight (`4.64 MB`), the curated typography archive is distributed independently from the **Fontivo-Fonts** repository (`v1.0.3`):

- **Total Unique Fonts:** `10,939` (SHA-256 deduplicated, zero corrupt or duplicate binaries)
- **Typographic Families:** `4,430`
- **Distribution Format:** `15` modular, SHA-256 verified ZIP packs
- **Total Compressed Archive Size:** `864.01 MB`
- **Script Distribution:**
  - **Latin:** `7,146` fonts (Sans-serif, Serif, Display, Monospace, Variable, Script)
  - **Urdu:** `1,565` fonts (Nastaliq, Naskh, Editorial, Calligraphy)
  - **Persian (Farsi):** `1,257` fonts (Modern UI, Display, Traditional)
  - **Arabic:** `971` fonts (Modern Sans, Kufic, Naskh, Ruq'ah, Diwani, Display)
- **Release URL:** https://github.com/Ahmedfahmy8308/Fontivo-Fonts/releases/tag/v1.0.3

## 5. Comparison: Fontivo vs FontBase, NexusFont & MainType

| Capability | Fontivo `v1.1.7` | FontBase | NexusFont | MainType |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **App Footprint** | Lightweight Native Desktop | Electron (Chromium) | Legacy Desktop | Proprietary Desktop |
| **Typical Idle Memory** | **~38 MB** | ~280–450 MB | ~45–90 MB | ~120–250 MB |
| **Price & Licensing** | **100% Free & MIT Open Source** | Freemium ($3/mo–$180) | Freeware (Closed Source) | Paid ($49–$199) |
| **Instant Session Activation (Zero Bloat)** | **Yes (Instant, Clean)** | Folder-based activation | Temporary load | Database-managed |
| **Adobe CC Auto-Sync** | **Built-in (Free & Offline)** | Paid tier only | No | Plugin / Paid |
| **Brand Workspaces & `.ASE` Color Studio** | **Built-in (with WCAG 2.1)** | No | No | No |
| **Curated Multi-Script Catalog (Arabic/Urdu/Persian/Latin)** | **10,939 SHA-256 verified fonts** | Google Fonts sync only | None included | None included |
| **Telemetry / Account Required** | **Zero telemetry, no account** | Account / Cloud sync | Offline | License activation |
| **Cross-Platform (Windows / macOS / Linux)** | **Yes** | Yes | Windows only | Windows only |

---

## 6. Brand Workspaces

**Brand Workspaces** let designers and agencies group client typography and brand colors into isolated, toggleable profiles:
- Bind specific font families and weights to a client or project workspace.
- Activate or deactivate an entire brand's typography set in RAM with a single click.
- Pair each workspace with its approved **Brand Color Studio** swatches (`.ASE` exportable).
- Eliminate cross-project font conflicts and keep system font menus uncluttered inside Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Figma.

---

## 7. Automatic Adobe Creative Cloud Font Syncing

Fontivo includes **100% offline Adobe CC Auto-Sync** built right in:
- Inspects local `.PSD` (Photoshop), `.AI` (Illustrator), `.INDD` (InDesign), and `.PDF` files to detect referenced fonts.
- Matches missing fonts against your indexed Fontivo libraries and Brand Workspaces.
- Automatically activates matching fonts so Adobe Creative Cloud apps resolve them without manual searching or cloud font subscriptions.
- **Strict On-Device Privacy:** Design files and font metadata never leave your machine.

---

## 8. Brand Color Studio & Accessibility

Built directly into the Fontivo desktop studio:
- **5x5 Pixel Loupe Picker:** Sample exact screen colors with precision zoom.
- **Live WCAG 2.1 Contrast Auditing:** Instant AA / AAA pass-fail ratio calculation for normal and large text.
- **Binary `.ASE` Swatch Export:** Export standards-compliant Adobe Swatch Exchange (`.ASE`) files for direct import into Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

---

## 9. Security, Privacy & Zero-Telemetry Guarantees

- **100% Local-First:** Fontivo functions completely offline after installation.
- **Zero Telemetry & Zero Tracking:** No analytics SDKs, no crash-report phone-homes, no tracking cookies, and no mandatory login or account creation.
- **Open-Source Auditability:** Full source code for the desktop app, font catalog manifest, and website is publicly auditable on GitHub under the **MIT License**.
- **SHA-256 Integrity Verification:** Every desktop installer (`Fontivo-Setup.exe`) and every one of the 15 `Fontivo-Fonts` ZIP packs publishes its canonical SHA-256 digest in `public/api/manifest.json` and on the `/download` page.
- **Standard User Execution:** Runs without Windows UAC Administrator elevation.

---

## 10. Concise FAQ (Quotable Q&A)

**Q: What is Fontivo?**
A: Fontivo is a free, MIT open-source desktop font manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux, paired with a curated 10,939-font multi-script library (`Fontivo-Fonts v1.0.3`).

**Q: Does Fontivo slow down Windows or clutter `C:\Windows\Fonts`?**
A: No. Fontivo activates fonts for your active session without copying thousands of files to `C:\Windows\Fonts` or leaving permanent system clutter. Everything unloads cleanly on exit.

**Q: How much memory does Fontivo use compared to FontBase?**
A: Fontivo uses approximately 38 MB of memory at idle and starts in under 0.35 seconds, compared to 280–450 MB for Electron-based managers like FontBase.

**Q: How does Fontivo's Adobe CC Auto-Sync work?**
A: Fontivo scans `.PSD`, `.AI`, `.INDD`, and `.PDF` files locally on your machine and automatically activates matching missing fonts inside Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign without uploading files to any cloud server.

**Q: What scripts are included in the 10,939-font Fontivo-Fonts library?**
A: `Fontivo-Fonts v1.0.3` contains 10,939 SHA-256 deduplicated fonts across 4,430 families in 15 ZIP packs (864.01 MB total): 7,146 Latin, 1,565 Urdu, 1,257 Persian, and 971 Arabic fonts.

**Q: Is Fontivo free for commercial and agency use?**
A: Yes. Fontivo Desktop is 100% free and open source under the MIT License with zero subscriptions, zero accounts, and zero telemetry.

**Q: How do I install Fontivo on Windows, macOS, and Linux?**
A: On Windows 10/11 (64-bit), download and run `Fontivo-Setup.exe` (4.64 MB, no admin rights required). On macOS and Linux, run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmedfahmy8308/Fontivo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`.
